# STUDY-PHASE NOTES (orchestrator; outcomes visible; train-era sessions) — pattern hypotheses forming
## case001 s394 2023-07-31 SHORT @13:04 — LOSER −$304 stop30
Read: mid-compression day (range 0.55 ATR), LH-retest continuation short after 15m slide. AT ENTRY the pack showed: depth_at_touch z+2.29 rising (defense stacking), absorption |move|/flow collapsing 0.41->0.04 (pushes eaten), signed_flow FLIPPED positive at the low (T-5m +4.8k, T-1m +5.3k) while price still drifted down, option_delta_dir z −3.48 (protection bid), both proxy_vol sides rising, 0DTE share collapsed. Forward: brief flat, then +80bp rally — short was into a completed exhaustion.
PATTERN SEEDS: (P-A1) ABSORPTION-AT-EXTREME VETO: {absorption ratio collapse} + {depth_at_touch z>+2} + {flow-sign flip against move} => move exhausted; veto continuation-side candidates, favor reversal side. (P-A2) OPTION-PROTECTION SPIKE: |option_delta_dir z| >= 3 against the move at a local extreme = reversal fuel marker. (P-A3) candidate side authority (watch-side) can CONTRADICT completed-setup side — the E/P letters adjudicate, not the watch origin.
## case002 s326 2023-04-21 LONG @15:59:59 — NEAR-MISS $5 (runway-capped)
Structurally dead late entry (1s before close) despite a genuinely strong buy-close tape (flow z+2.4 vs close-norm, depth z+1.9, 0DTE vol spike). LESSON (P-B1): REMAINING RUNWAY is a first-class R-component; near-close candidates carry ~zero ceilings; population hygiene for training + a hard runway factor in any deployable gate.
## case003 s212 2022-11-04 LONG @13:58 — WINNER +$1,603 MAE $256
High-ATR era (255bp). Sequence: all-day decline -> flow z −6 CAPITULATION burst 13:36 -> 50min BASE (down-pushes absorbed: absorption 0.02-0.14, depth accel +, ZigZag flattening, refails clustering) -> LONG at base edge while sellers still pressing but achieving nothing -> MAE $256 stayed INSIDE the base's prior penetration -> 2.5h rally +$1,600.
PATTERN (P-C1) CLIMAX->BASE->ABSORB entry: {flow z-spike <= −4 (climax)} then {>=20min base: swing flattening + absorption low + refail count >= 2} then {enter reversal side at base edge}; stop tolerance = base penetration depth (F20), NOT a fixed dollar.
PHASE-CONDITIONAL OPTIONS RULE (P-C2, from 001 vs 003 contrast): protection-flow spike AT A FRESH EXTREME (delta-dir z <= −3 while the move is still running) => reversal imminent, veto continuation entries (001). ABSENT/soft protection at an AGED post-climax base => sellers exhausted, reversal side safe (003). Same feature, opposite meaning, adjudicated by H-phase. Single-feature rules cannot encode this; the phase x optionflow interaction can.
## case004 s189 2022-10-04 SHORT @13:57 — NEAR-MISS $274 (MAE $34)
Short into a bounce carrying +6.3z certified stock buying AND +7.9z option delta demand (both streams sponsoring the bounce). Never hurt (stall entry) but captured nothing. (P-D1) CROSS-STREAM AGREEMENT VETO: both streams >= +4z opposite the candidate side => stand aside. MAGNITUDE LAW vs case001: subtle counter-flow flip (~0.6z) at a fresh extreme = absorption clue; violent aligned counter-flow (>=4z) = sponsorship. W2.1 typed-absent (pre-s209) handled gracefully.
## case005 s204 2022-10-25 LONG @12:22 — LOSER (top; stopped; day bled −140bp after)
Trend-continuation long at +3% day at the 28d-high zone. Pack showed: price UP on PERSISTENTLY NEGATIVE stock flow all hour (F21 divergence live: −1.6k -> −13k cumulative, z −1.7) + option_delta z +6.4, option_volume z +5.1 (call chase) + late-stage R (~1.8 ATR spent... range extended). Immediate distribution top. (P-E1) DIVERGENT GRIND TOP: {price up} x {stock flow z<0 sustained} x {option delta z >= +4} x {multi-day-high location, late phase} => veto longs / favor short.
## SYNTHESIS FORMING: F23 CROSS-STREAM STANCE MAP (the codified cross-stream feature)
2D state: (certified stock-flow z RELATIVE TO MOVE) x (option delta-flow z RELATIVE TO MOVE), conditioned on (location letter, phase letter). Observed verdict quadrants so far: [subtle flow-flip + protection spike @ fresh extreme] = reversal fuel (001); [both aligned violent] = sponsorship, no fade (004); [flow against move + option chase with move @ aged high] = distribution (005); [absent protection @ post-climax base] = exhaustion, join reversal (003). One object, four verdicts, phase-adjudicated — this is the pattern-family centerpiece.
## case006 s149 2022-08-08 SHORT @15:39 — NEAR-MISS +$155 (right direction, runway-capped; MAE $120 = poke into the LH cluster: stops belong beyond STRUCTURE)
## case007 s238 2022-12-13 (CPI gap-day) SHORT @10:24 — WINNER +$1,772 MAE $137
(P-F1) TRAPPED-DIP-BUYER CONTINUATION: {LL/LH stairstep} + {OPPOSING aggressor flow z>=3 (dip-buyers hitting asks)} + {depth wall z>=4 against them (offer stacked)} + {options NOT confirming the dip (delta<=0)} => continuation with opponents as fuel. MIRROR-LAW of case001: absorption AGAINST your side vetoes; absorption OF YOUR OPPONENTS fuels. The flow sign must be read RELATIVE TO STRUCTURE, not to the last tick.
## case008 s271 2023-02-01 (FOMC) LONG @15:42 — LOSER (blowoff top; −$2.20 after)
(P-G1) BLOWOFF EXHAUSTION: {parabolic HH/HL stack} + {flow flip negative at marginal high} + {spread WIDENING z>+2} + {depth THINNING z<−2} + {vol bid + 0DTE spike} + {event-day phase} => top; veto longs. FIVE independent witnesses. Liquidity-withdrawal-at-top = one-market F14.
## case009 s282 2023-02-16 SHORT @10:23 — LOSER (sponsored breakout against)
P-D1 at max violence: final-minute flow z +13.9 aligned with options +2.3z and FALLING vol = sponsored push; range-top fades die. vs case007: fadeable push = unsponsored + walled + option-unconfirmed.
## case010 s395 2023-08-01 LONG @10:04 — LOSER (elephant exit)
(P-H1) ELEPHANT-EXIT VETO: recent (<=10min) extreme one-sided flow event (−315k shares/5m) defines the dominant hand; counter-pushes on FALLING urgency (z −1.6) are drift, not reversal; do not join against a fresh elephant without a base+refail sequence (P-C1).
## STUDY-PHASE CONSOLIDATED INVENTORY (10 cases, 2022-08..2023-08)
Named: P-A1 absorption-at-extreme veto; P-A2 option-protection spike; P-A3 setup-completeness>watch-side; P-B1 runway law; P-C1 climax->base->absorb entry; P-C2 phase-conditional protection rule; P-D1 cross-stream agreement veto + magnitude law; P-E1 divergent grind top; P-F1 trapped-opponent continuation (structure-relative flow); P-G1 blowoff exhaustion (5-witness); P-H1 elephant-exit veto. CENTERPIECE: F23 CROSS-STREAM STANCE MAP (stock-flow z, option-delta z | phase, location, structure-direction) — at least 6 distinct verdict cells observed in 10 cases. SUPPORTING PAIR: depth-wall z x aggressor-flow z (decisive in 001/007/008). All patterns are 2-5-factor INTERACTIONS; not one single-feature rule survived contact with the cases.
